verdict.rationale: Weave is an LLM observability/evaluation platform, not an autonomous agent that executes tasks using tools; the evidence available (wandb-weave-docs-44, wandb-weave-docs-20, wandb-weave-probe-4) shows the reverse relationship — Weave exposes an MCP server so coding agents like Claude Code can pull Weave's data, not Weave itself consuming external MCP servers' tools. This 'plug MCP servers in so it can use their tools' story is a client-role/agentic axis that doesn't fit Weave's product category.
